reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-7 (lead tusd-trueusd)
reserveReview.rationale: The live single-asset adapter publishes one aggregate BRL fiat reserves row, so the reviewed classification is keyed to that exact 100% identity. Transfero's issuer report describes BRZ as redeemable one-for-one for reais and states that the reserve is held at a financial institution authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil. The accessible report is dated March 31, 2024 and does not name the institution or disclose additional reserve instruments.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Transfero BRZ transparency report dated March 31, 2024
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer discloses a single authorized-institution reserve category but not the institution name, account terms, liquidity terms, segregation, or a current report.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: A Brazilian-real bank deposit is an external reserve asset rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Undisclosed financial institution authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer report says the reserve is held at an authorized Brazilian financial institution, but does not name it or disclose segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, rehypothecation, or account-level terms.
